text:
Ellen: FYI budget alert: west-prod GPU pool exceeded team budget by 62% this week. Appears linked to a customer PoC under SalesPlaybook but billing lines are attributed to infra-shared. Need to decide whether to absorb or reassign to customer POC budget.
Ravi: I can see the lines. Sample BQ: SELECT invoice_id, cost, labels.owner, protoPayload.resourceName FROM `billing.gcp.lines_*` WHERE sku LIKE '%GPU%' AND usage_start_time >= '2026-05-10' AND labels.owner = 'infra-shared' LIMIT 50
Noah: Quick note - the PoC cluster was spun up via the sales portal; portal should have set customer_poc tag but a deploy race removed it. I have the portal logs showing the missing label for cluster poc-42.
Tess: Sales ops says customer agreed to cover up to $10k but we already hit $9.1k in three days. If we can reattribute those lines to the customer account we avoid hitting team overage limits.
billing-bot: Alert: budget_threshold_exceeded for cost_center infra-shared, delta +62% vs expected. Ticket: BILL-5932 https://billing.internal/tickets/BILL-5932
Ellen: Plan: (1) @Noah export per-line charge CSV and portal log snippet, (2) @Ravi run backfill mapping to customer_poc label, (3) Finance will draft internal memo and adjust ledgers if mapping proves deterministic. Can we get artifacts by EOD?
Ravi: I can backfill for lines that have portal_trace_id present. If trace id missing we'll need manual review. I'll aim for CSV in /shared/finance/poc_reassign/ by 6pm PT.
Noah: Uploading logs now. Also opening infra PR to add a pre-commit that blocks portal deploys without a customer tag.
Tess: Sales ops will ping the customer to confirm acceptance of charges if we reissue invoice.
Ellen: Thanks. If we can't conclusively reassign, Finance prefers an internal charge to SalesPlaybook budget rather than stretching infra-shared.
Ravi: Understood. I'll include a flag column in CSV for "reassignable" (YES/NO).
Ellen: Good. Keep thread updated. Thanks team.
